patthana18.22:1.1: Sārammaṇaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasārammaṇo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:2.1: Sārammaṇaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanārammaṇo nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Anārammaṇaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanārammaṇo nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Sārammaṇaṃ nahetuñca anārammaṇaṃ nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca naanārammaṇo nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:3.1: Nocittaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanocitto nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:4.1: Cittaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:5.1: Cetasikaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nacetasiko nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:6.1: Cetasikaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naacetasiko nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:7.1: Cittasampayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nacittasampayutto nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana18.22:9.1: Cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nacittasaṃsaṭṭho nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana18.22:11.1: Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasamuṭṭhāno nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana18.22:13.1: Cittasahabhuṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasahabhū nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana18.22:15.1: Cittānuparivattiṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittānuparivattī nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana18.22:17.1: Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana18.22:19.1: Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana18.22:21.1: Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattī nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana18.22:23.1: Bāhiraṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nabāhiro nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:24.1: Ajjhattikaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naajjhattiko nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:25.1: Noupādā hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanoupādā nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:26.1: Upādā nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noupādā nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:27.1: Upādinnaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naupādinno nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana18.22:28.1: Anupādinnaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naupādinno nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ… hetuyā cattāri.
patthana18.22:29.1: Upādinnaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanupādinno nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana18.22:30.1: Anupādinnaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naupādinno nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ… hetuyā dve.
